officialTitle: Nivolumab versus Docetaxel in Advanced Squamous-Cell Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: We randomly assigned 272 patients to receive nivolumab

clinicalQuestion: Does nivolumab improve overall survival over docetaxel in previously treated advanced squamous NSCLC?

pico.population: Advanced squamous NSCLC with progression during or after first-line chemotherapy
pico.outcomes: Primary: OS. Secondary: ORR, PFS, PD-L1 association, safety

arms.label: Nivolumab
arms.doseSourceQuote: to receive nivolumab, at a dose of 3 mg per kilogram of body weight every 2 weeks

arms.label: Docetaxel
arms.doseSourceQuote: or docetaxel, at a dose of 75 mg per square meter of body-surface area every 3 weeks

publications.title: Nivolumab versus Docetaxel in Advanced Squamous-Cell Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: The median overall survival was 9.2 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 7.3 to 13.3) with nivolumab versus 6.0 months (95% CI, 5.1 to 7.3) with docetaxel. The risk of death was 41% lower with nivolumab than with docetaxel (hazard ratio, 0.59; 95% CI, 0.44 to 0.79; P<0.001). At 1 year, the overall survival rate was 42% (95% CI, 34 to 50) with nivolumab versus 24% (95% CI, 17 to 31) with docetaxel.
The response rate was 20% with nivolumab versus 9% with docetaxel (P=0.008).
The median progression-free survival was 3.5 months with nivolumab versus 2.8 months with docetaxel (hazard ratio for death or disease progression, 0.62; 95% CI, 0.47 to 0.81; P<0.001).

safety.description: Treatment-related adverse events of grade 3 or 4
safety.sourceQuote: Treatment-related adverse events of grade 3 or 4 were reported in 7% of the patients in the nivolumab group as compared with 55% of those in the docetaxel group.

strengths: Randomised phase III with OS as primary endpoint
Benefit observed irrespective of PD-L1 expression
limitations: Population pre-dates first-line immunotherapy, limiting applicability to current second-line practice

clinicalImplications.text: Established PD-1 blockade over docetaxel for previously treated advanced squamous NSCLC, regardless of PD-L1 expression.

tumourBoardPearl.text: In squamous NSCLC in this trial, PD-L1 was neither prognostic nor predictive of nivolumab benefit.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 26028407. Long-term pooled CheckMate 017/057 updates not ingested.
